name: vajra
description: Meta skill creator that generates routed workflow skills from a developer's stated way of working.

scripts.examples: for d in examples/*/; do rm -rf "$d/scripts" && mkdir -p "$d/scripts" && cp -r skills/vajra/scripts/flow.mjs skills/vajra/scripts/validate.mjs skills/vajra/scripts/lib "$d/scripts/" && node skills/vajra/scripts/validate.mjs "$d" --project "${d%/}.project.md" --write-graph || exit 1; done
